nodes.question: What are the two groups that the studies were categorized into?
nodes.answer: The studies were categorized into electronic surgical devices (EHDs used to conduct surgical procedures) and electronic non-surgical devices (EHDs that offer clinical or non-clinical services that do not involve surgery).
